bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
src=/home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/create-videobot
cid=gace-createvdobot-videobot-poll-1
test -d "$src/.git" || { echo CREATEVDOBOT_CHECKOUT=NOT_FOUND; exit 61; }
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_CHECKOUT_HEAD=%s\n' "$(git -C "$src" rev-parse HEAD)"
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_TRACKED_DIRTY_COUNT=%s\n' "$(git -C "$src" status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l | tr -d ' ')"
state="$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.State.Running}}' 2>/dev/null || echo unavailable)"
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_SINGLE_POLLER_RUNNING=%s\n' "$state"
test "$state" = true || exit 62
printf 'CREATEVDOBOT_ACTIVE_IMAGE_SHA=%s\n' "$(docker inspect "$cid" --format '{{.Image}}')"
if docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq 'creatorDescriptionPanel' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/creatorWizard.mjs; then echo VIDEO_OPTIONAL_DESCRIPTION_LIVE=YES; else echo VIDEO_OPTIONAL_DESCRIPTION_LIVE=NO; fi
if docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq '購入者都合の通常返金なし' /opt/videobot/src/telegram/paidListingPublisher.mjs; then echo VIDEO_NO_REFUND_NOTICE_LIVE=YES; else echo VIDEO_NO_REFUND_NOTICE_LIVE=NO; fi
if docker exec "$cid" grep -Fq 'VIDEO_TOPIC_NOT_CONNECTED' /opt/videobot/src/owner/gateOwner.mjs; then echo VIDEO_GATE_ADAPTER_STUB_PRESENT=YES; else echo VIDEO_GATE_ADAPTER_STUB_PRESENT=NO_OR_DIFFERENT; fi
if docker exec "$cid" test -f /opt/videobot/src/sales/pgUnifiedStarsSales.mjs; then echo UNIFIED_STARS_SALES_MODULE_LIVE=YES; else echo UNIFIED_STARS_SALES_MODULE_LIVE=NO; fi
